question.worked_solution:
If we attempt to evaluate the limit, we get an indeterminate form:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{y\to 0}\frac{7{y}^{6}-3{y}^{4}}{5{y}^{5}+10{y}^{4}} & =\frac{7(0)^{6}-3(0)^{4}}{5(0)^{5}+10(0)^{4}}=\frac{0}{0}\end{aligned}
$$

So, to find the limit, we have to factor the numerator and the denominator. We get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7{y}^{6}-3{y}^{4}}{5{y}^{5}+10{y}^{4}} & =\frac{{y}^{4}(7{y}^{2}-3)}{{y}^{4}(5y+10)} \\  & =\frac{7{y}^{2}-3}{5y+10}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{y\to 0}\frac{7{y}^{6}-3{y}^{4}}{5{y}^{5}+10{y}^{4}} & ={lim}_{y\to 0}\frac{7{y}^{2}-3}{5y+10} \\  & =\frac{7(0)-3}{5(0)+10} \\  & =-\frac{3}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
